articles.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million. Most avoided exchanges
articles.snippet: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.

articles.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
articles.snippet: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.

articles.title: The Clarity Act slipped to September. Banks are building anyway
articles.snippet: But every month without settled rules quietly rewards the walled garden, writes Matter Labs’ Vassilis Tziokas.

articles.title: Ethena looks beyond crypto to squeeze yield from booming equity perpetuals
articles.snippet: The issuer of the $4 billion USDe token said it expects real-world asset perpetuals to eclipse crypto derivatives in its backing within 12 to 24 months.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits highest level in 3 months before pulling back as altcoins consolidate
articles.snippet: BTC briefly touched $81,455 overnight, its highest since May 15 as Nasdaq futures slipped and gold extended gains heading into the weekend.
